n: Movement and Visual AI (Model AI Assignment 2022)
t: A three-day lesson on computer vision with Scratch and pose tracking.
steps: Find the Model AI Assignment 2022 Movement page and download the day plans.
Read the plan for your grade band, middle school or high school.
Check that students have some Scratch experience.
Test the browser tools on a student device before class.
Check that the device has a camera. The page implies this for PoseBlocks but does not state it.
Run the live Quick Draw demo on day one.
Choose the Scratch track or the optional Teachable Machine variant.
